Financial Support
Assistantships and Fellowships
We are dedicated to helping you fund your graduate education and offer these Lehigh internally-funded options:
Teaching Assistantships
TAs must be regular full-time students, which requires registration for nine credit hours or full-time certification per semester. Funding is administered by each academic department and includes a stipend and tuition remission. The duties of TAs are determined by the department and are outlined in a formal letter of appointment from the department. For information, please contact the graduate director in your program of interest.
Research Assistantships
RAs must be regular full-time students, which requires registration for nine credit hours or full-time certification per semester. Funding is administered by a department or an individual faculty member with an ongoing research project. RAs receive a stipend for research services and tuition remission, which is generally paid by the research project. For information, please contact the graduate director in your program of interest.
Fellowships & Scholarships
Lehigh offers a limited number of distinguished fellowships and scholarships for outstanding graduate students. Academic departments may nominate candidates, who are then selected by a faculty committee. Awards may include multi-year stipends and tuition support. For information, please contact the graduate director in your program of interest.
Graduate
Tuition and Fees
Average fees for full-time grad students enrolled in the 2026/2027 academic year:
$15,615 per semester, based on 9 credits @ $1735 per credit hour
$630 annual technology fee
$250 annual wellness fee
$2,860 annual student health insurance coverage (Lehigh may subsidize up to 80% of this cost. Please review the details here.)
Please refer to the Graduate Tuition & Fees Schedule for more information.
Additional Resources
Other important resources to help you navigate funding your graduate education:
Billing Information: The Bursar’s Office generates tuition statements, in mid-July for fall semester and mid-December for spring semester. Please visit their website for specific information and to confirm payment deadlines.
Graduate Fee Schedule: Tuition rates and all applicable fees are available here.
Graduate Payment Plan: Lehigh offers a payment plan that allows you to pay each semester’s expenses in installments. Details for setting up a payment plan are available here.
Loans: The Office of Financial Aid processes various federal and alternative student loans for graduate students. Please visit their website to learn more about the available resources and application process.
Yellow Ribbon Program: Lehigh University participates in the Yellow Ribbon Program, which is administered by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. Learn more about this benefit here.
